test_policy.notes: 'Minnesota State Mankato is test-optional for admissions.' International applicants: SAT/ACT optional, and the international page states no ACT/SAT minimum. Domestic automatic admission: HS GPA 3.0+, top 50% of class, or ACT 21+ with 2.7 GPA.

requirements.notes: Apply through Minnesota State Mankato's eServices (create a StarID); $20 non-refundable fee, payable after submitting. International first-year applicants need cumulative secondary results equivalent to a U.S. 3.0 GPA or better. F-1/J-1 applicants are not eligible for the comprehensive-review route. Applicants from Bangladesh, Kyrgyzstan, Malawi, Pakistan and Uganda must also complete an admission interview.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 (students needing an F-1 visa)
deadlines.notes: Applicants who already hold an active F-1 visa: Aug. 10. The page gives no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. No priority dates are published.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Alternatives to a test: Intensive English Program (IEP) at Minnesota State Mankato with a B+ average and at least a B in each Advanced course; ELS level 112; SAT Reading 400+; ACT English 15+; or one semester of freshman English composition with C or better at a U.S. college. Aviation-Professional Flight and Nursing require higher scores (numbers not given on the page).

english.notes: Tests before 2026-01-21. Higher for Nursing and Aviation-Professional Flight.
Tests after 2026-01-21 (page does not name the 1-6 scale).

aid.notes: All degree-seeking international bachelor's students automatically receive the International Maverick Scholarship unless they opt out; it cuts estimated tuition and fees from $21,013 to $13,137 (a $7,876 difference). The cost page does not list the renewal requirements.
